items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I played the banjo, and Cripple Smitty was on drums.

ctx.x: We didn't have too many piano players playing fish bars, Smitty.

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: When we all walked in... Mushid(?) said, 'Wait a while, let me explain to you.' ... 'We are Muslims.'

ctx.x: What Mushid(?) went and got the rooms?

When we all walked in, the manager said "Wait. I have no rooms. Mushid(?) said, "Wait a while, let me explain to you." And he kept walking... He was always crippled; he had a gimpy leg.
